title: Book-level $ simulation per account at its real size with the PRODUCTION position sizer and risk caps (concurrency, per-account caps, daily_dd_switch where armed), multi-symbol across the account's whole strategies: roster, with in-trade levers (break-even after peak first) applied in the simulated monitor path; the measurement of record for RULE-AM-RISK-ADJUSTED-V1 (delta net $ and % return of the book; drawdown / CVaR in $ and %)
note: Filed by lane AM-RISK-ADJUSTED-RULE 2026-10-29 on the operator's ~07:20Z requirement (verbatim on row AM-RISK-ADJUSTED-RULE): grade on a book-level $ simulation per account so three effects that a per-trade R test cannot see are counted: (1) freed risk budget admits trades the caps would refuse; (2) compounding under %-of-equity sizing; (3) prop survival vs daily DD limits. MEASURED gap, 2026-10-29: scripts/backtest_system.py simulates ONE shared netted book on ONE symbol, and its sizing MIRRORS RiskManager.position_size (re-implemented, _risk_qty) rather than importing it. scripts/research/nbook_portfolio.py runs N books over one tick stream with the same mirrored sizer. Neither models daily_dd_switch or a multi-symbol account roster (bybit_2 is 5 legs on 4 symbols), and neither applies a harness exit lever: --be-floor-r lives only in the per-strategy harnesses, and the live monitor() does not model be_floor_r (src/runtime/bracket_advisor.py _UNMODELLED_SL_KEYS). Done when: a simulator replays an account's roster with the production sizer and caps imported (not copied), passes a parity test against backtest_system at N=1 / one symbol, takes an in-trade lever arm plus matched random-control arms, and emits per-account books ($ and %) that am_risk_adjusted.grade_risk_adjusted can grade (net $ in place of net R; R per trade reported beside). Until then the R-unit grade is a SCREEN, never a graduation. Blocks RQ-20261029-1f39-01 together with HARNESS-BE-RANDOM-CONTROL.
